title: BONFIRE – Bonn Oncology Framework for Insights from Real-World Evidence: Retrospective Analyses of the CIO Cancer Registry Bonn on Treatment Outcomes, Biomarkers and Health Services Research in Oncology
summary: Cancer patients at the University Hospital Bonn receive treatments that are carefully documented. This project retrospectively analyzes these existing records to understand which treatments are most effective, which characteristics influence the course of disease, and how care can be further improved. No new examinations or interventions are performed on patients.

interventions.name: Retrospective analysis of clinical routine data from adult oncology patients in the CIO Cancer Registry Bonn. No intervention is performed. Pseudonymized longitudinal data on diagnosis, therapy, biomarkers and survival are analyzed.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Adult patients (≥18 years) with malignant oncological diseases whose clinical routine data are documented in the CIO Cancer Registry Bonn. All entities of solid tumors and hematological neoplasms are included (ICD-10: C00–C97).
Exclusion criteria:
Incomplete or unusable data records; patients without documented follow-up data in the CIO registry; records outside the defined observation period.
